context_for_next_testing_agent: Help & Support Nova fix verified working across all viewports. Contact tab is now the default, chat input is visible within viewport, and message send/receive works correctly. The embedded NovaChatPanel uses dynamic height calculation to ensure composer is always visible.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - Fix verified working. Root cause was: (1) Help defaulted to Support tab instead of Contact, (2) NovaChatPanel allocated too much height to welcome/message content pushing composer below fold, (3) Large curation blocks below panel worsened the issue. All fixed by: defaulting to Contact tab, using embedded surfaceVariant with compact heights, and reducing curation summary sizes.
